This is where water clarifying agents like these AquaPacs can help. They bind up these smaller particles into larger conglomerates that are more easily pulled from the water by the filter. My poor old boy Pumpkin has started showing signs of slowing down and signs of infection.  I'm trying my best to treat him, and hoping he can recover.  sadly it's been a very tough summer for the aquarium hobby. and the heat waves in the UK have made it very difficult to maintain lower temperatures in the aquarium. some days the water has reached 30⁰c!! these high temperatures can put stress on fish, and can affect their immune system.  after losing Ponyo in the first heatwave in June, I have been trying everything to maintain lower temperatures in my tank.  sadly I now feel that Pumpkin has started to be affected too after yet another heatwave this week.  I'm really hoping that the treatments will work, and the UK will become cooler again soon.  #goldfish #fish #fyp #aquarium #fishkeeping
